description: This Java source file defines the AdminClient class, which communicates with a running OFBiz server instance via network socket commands to request server status or shutdown.

classes.name: AdminClient
classes.description: A utility class for communicating with an OFBiz server to request status or shutdown via socket commands.

methods.name: requestStatus
methods.description: Requests the current status of the OFBiz server (e.g., running, stopping).

methods.name: requestShutdown
methods.description: Sends a shutdown command to the OFBiz server.

methods.name: sendSocketCommand
methods.description: Handles the socket communication to send a command and receive a response from the server.
